description: TfL aggregates its 2023 public transport accessibility grid to Middle Super Output Areas. The source describes minimum, maximum and mean access-index statistics, with mean indices classified into PTAL categories. The polygon schema contains 2021 MSOA codes and names, median and other index fields. The underlying 100 m grid uses walking access and service frequency. CSV and feature-service items describe the same aggregate resource; LSOA and ward aggregations are separate spatial resolutions. Coverage is Greater London. Access is through the published ArcGIS feature service and alternate item listings. Licence and cost: The source states OGL-UK-3.0. Caveats: only item, service and layer metadata were inspected. No feature records were downloaded, and current completeness, geometric quality and operational availability remain untested. Access charges are not stated in the inspected metadata. The resource provides planning or policy-area inputs; applying it in a simulation requires checking the source limits and relevant model assumptions. Related resources include the existing TfL 2023 PTAL grid.
